title: AC1021 AutoCAD 2007 TABLE full cell spans and value references
scope: Extend the source-bound AC1021 AutoCAD 2007 TABLE trace from two alignment fields to every cell body/text/handle range and per-cell value reference in the same two table objects.

authority.document: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1
relevantRules: ODA §2.2 assigns handle reference code 5 to a hard pointer.
ODA §20.4.96.1 defines per-cell H group 344 (text) and 340 (block) value references as hard pointers; ATTDEF references are soft pointers.
ODA §20.4.96.1 defines the pre-R24 cell layout and separate R2007+ cell data/value streams.
ODA §20.4.99 defines CadValue fields independently of the per-cell value-handle reference.

source.fixtureDisposition: Existing local external sample; read-only. No DWG/DXF fixture or derivative was committed.

independentReaderTrace.instrumentation: Scratch-only instrumentation records field bit positions, cell/value/stream bounds, object-map boundaries, and the raw high nibble at each cell value-handle H. It restores the reader position before ordinary handle decode; the pinned ACadSharp checkout was not modified.

build.result: Succeeded, 0 errors; peer build reported 1489 warnings.

observations.cellRanges: Every row-major cell has contiguous, non-overlapping body, text, and handle ranges.

libdxfrwCrossCheck.readResult: The source read completed with 4408/4408 observed frames, zero entity/object parse failures, zero pending frames, and no R2007 TABLE cell-incomplete diagnostic.

qualificationBoundary: This binds exact per-cell spans and value-handle roles for two tables in the classified AutoCAD 2007 source. Peer interpretation is not wire authority; ODA v5.4.1 supplies field/role mapping. It does not prove full FIELD graph semantics, selected-TABLE output/readback, native rendering, or other AC1021 producer layouts. P5-I and P5-B remain open; no support claim is promoted.
